chunks: And he, peace be upon him, was asked: What is the definition of generosity?
He said: “It is that you bring out from your wealth the due which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made obligatory upon you, then place it in its proper place.”

key_terms.الْحَقَّ الَّذِي أَوْجَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَزّ: the due that Allah has made obligatory upon you from your wealth
key_terms.حَدُّ السَّخَاءِ: the defining limit or true meaning of generosity
key_terms.فِي مَوْضِعِهِ: in its proper place, meaning its rightful destination

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام define generosity in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith defines true generosity not as mere voluntary giving, but as fulfilling the financial rights that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has obligated from one’s wealth. It also emphasizes that such wealth must be directed to its proper place, linking generosity to both obligation and correct distribution.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5898 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked:
"What is the definition of generosity?"
Imam (as) replied: "It is to give from your wealth the rightful dues that Allah (swt), the Almighty, has obligated upon you, and to place it in its appropriate place."
